assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery alongside nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current management strategies.
The service is consistent with the medical necessity of CPT 93229.
The diagnosis codes are I25.10, I34.0, and R00.2.
